requirement: The system shall allow users to connect an Aeternity wallet and create predictions by specifying the asset, target price, start and end times, and outcome NFT media. The system shall interpret user-entered times according to an explicit timezone rule and submit prediction creation through the connected wallet.

The system shall allow wallet-connected users to view predictions, provide funds for and rent outcome NFTs, withdraw funds, and claim rewards under the contract rules after prediction outcomes have been determined.
The system shall load and display the corresponding outcome NFT images or animations from prediction media storage when users view prediction details or outcome NFTs.

After a prediction closes, the system shall automatically initiate outcome determination through the prediction-processing service. The oracle service shall periodically process pending queries, obtain the relevant external asset price, and report whether it is higher than or lower than or equal to the target price; the on-chain contract shall use that result to determine the winning outcome and make rewards available for claiming under the contract rules.

The oracle service shall run on Quarkus, check its registration at startup and periodically during operation, register when needed, and extend its validity before expiry when the configured threshold is reached. Operators shall be able to supply the required node and compiler connections, network, scheduling periods, fees, keys, and validity-management settings through external runtime configuration, which shall be complete before startup.
The system shall maintain and use an AENS name to locate the deployed on-chain contract.

The system shall maintain each prediction's asset, target price, start and end times, lifecycle state, determined outcome, and outcome NFT information, together with the associated funding, rental, withdrawal, and reward-claiming data.
